summary: Advanced Drainage Systems filed an 8-K disclosing an October 1, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement under which ADS and subsidiary ADS Investment LLC will acquire all equity interests of StormTrap Investments, L.L.C. from StormTrap Investors, L.L.C. and other sellers for approximately $530 million, or about $450 million adjusted for the present value of expected tax benefits, subject to purchase price adjustments. The purchase is funded with cash on hand and existing credit facility borrowings. Closing remains subject to customary conditions, including antitrust approvals; the Company obtained representations and warranties insurance. Watch regulatory clearance timing and integration execution.
